name: Upload a baseline into a season
description: Admin only, and THE ONLY WAY A BASELINE REACHES THE PLATFORM: no image, release or bootstrap carries one, and a season starts with none. The body is a name and the two hashes, exactly as a competitor's submission is, and the answer carries two one-shot presigned PUTs for the model and its manifest. The version is recorded `testing`, and the admit clock admits it by the walk every submission takes -- the node fetches and re-hashes the bytes, reads the graph, runs the adapters over the reference observations and measures the class -- then lands it `disabled`, not `verified`: a baseline has no trial, and it is out of play until an admin enables it, as an uploaded map is. THE NAME IS THE BASELINE: its account is `baseline.<slug of the name>`, so the same name in a later season is the same baseline with a new version, and one name holds one version a season. Refused in order: an unknown season, a closed one, a name with no usable slug, hashes that are not sha256:<64 hex>, and a name this season already has, unless that upload was rejected. POSTing the same name and hashes again while it is still `testing` answers 200 with fresh URLs, and creates nothing. One set of weights may stand under several names -- each is its own account and rating, which is how a trial on an eight-seat board finds seven opponents. The season's entry rules are not asked: they are a competitor's quotas, and admission still applies the season's graph and class rules. Its rate is per_admin_board_rate, as a season's boards and baselines arrive together.

with.name: Admins only
with.description: The role is read off the live session rather than off a claim in the cookie, so revoking a session or demoting a user takes effect on the next request.

tasks.name: The season, the name, and what it already holds

body.detail: A closed season's baselines are its record; nothing is added to them.
A baseline's name is 1 to 48 characters and must leave a slug: letters or digits.

with.name: A name that makes an account

body.detail: weights_hash and manifest_hash are each sha256: followed by 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters.

with.name: One version a name a season
with.description: A baseline's ratings describe the bytes it played, so its model never changes under it within a season. A different model is a different name; an upload admission rejected frees the name.
